Who was the 5th Prime Minister of Pakistan?
The first five prime ministers were Liaquat Ali Khan, Nazimuddin, Bogra, Chaudhry Muhammad Ali and then H. S. Suhrawardy. Fazal Elahi Chaudhry was a President, not a Prime Minister.
Suhrawardy served from September 1956 to October 1957 and was followed by I. I. Chundrigar.
Following BODMAS, 4 + 4x4 is not (4 + 4)x4 which would be 32.
What is the transpose of a matrix of order 4x3?
The transpose swaps rows and columns, so a 4x3 matrix becomes a 3x4 matrix.
The transpose of the transpose of a matrix gives back the original matrix.
If a helicopter covers 320 miles using 80 gallons of fuel, how many gallons are needed for 700 miles?
Fuel per mile = 80 / 320 = 0.25 gallons. For 700 miles: 700 x 0.25 = 175 gallons.
Such questions are solved with direct proportion: more distance needs proportionally more fuel.
If the 2nd day of a month is Friday, what day will the 8th day be?
From the 2nd to the 8th is 6 days. Friday plus 6 days is Thursday.
Six days after any day equals one day before it.
In a school of 3000 students, 2700 are present. What percentage of students are absent?
Present students are 90% of the total.
By which title is Hazrat Abdullah ibn Abbas (RA) well known?
Abdullah ibn Abbas was a great scholar of Quranic interpretation, so he is called Tarjuman-ul-Quran (interpreter of the Quran). He is also called Hibr-ul-Ummah.
Saifullah is the title of Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed (RA).
Who was Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) in relation to the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
He was the son of Hazrat Abbas (RA), the uncle of the Prophet (PBUH), so he was the Prophet's cousin.
He was born about three years before the Hijrat.
What is the full form of OGRA in Pakistan?
Office of Gas and Rail Authority
OGRA stands for Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority. It regulates the midstream and downstream oil and gas sector of Pakistan.
At what age did Dr Abdul Qadeer Khan, the father of Pakistan's nuclear programme, die?
He was born on 1 April 1936 and died on 10 October 2021, which makes him 85 years old.
He died in Islamabad and was buried in the H-8 graveyard.
Who was Hazrat Halima Sadia (RA) in relation to the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
Hazrat Halima Sadia of Banu Saad nursed and raised the infant Prophet (PBUH) in the desert, so she was his foster mother.
The Prophet's real mother was Hazrat Amina.
In which year was the 1962 constitution of Pakistan abrogated?
General Yahya Khan took over after Ayub Khan resigned and abrogated the 1962 constitution in March 1969 by imposing martial law.
The 1962 constitution had been introduced by Ayub Khan.
Who among the companions accompanied the Holy Prophet (PBUH) during the Hijrat to Madina?
Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) accompanied the Prophet (PBUH) on the journey and stayed with him in the Cave of Thaur.
Hazrat Ali (RA) stayed behind in Makkah to return the trusts of the people.
Insert the correct form of the verb: Lightning ____ across the bridge last night.
The words last night show past time, so the simple past tense flashed is needed.
The past participle of flash is also flashed.
Change to active voice: Why was the thief seen by Ali?
Why did Ali see the thief?
Why had Ali seen the thief?
Why was Ali seeing the thief?
The past simple passive was seen becomes did ... see in the active, with Ali as the subject and the thief as the object.
In the active voice the doer of the action is the subject of the sentence.
In which year did Allama Iqbal deliver his famous Presidential Address at the Allahabad session of the Muslim League?
Allama Iqbal gave his Allahabad Address in 1930, in which he proposed a separate Muslim state in north-west India.
He gave a series of lectures at Madras and other places in 1928-29, which became Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam.
On what date did Allama Iqbal deliver his Allahabad Address?
The Allahabad session of the All India Muslim League was held in December 1930 and Iqbal delivered his address on 29 December 1930.
The idea of a separate Muslim state he gave there led to the Pakistan Resolution of 1940.
Which prophet confronted the king Namrood (Nimrod)?
Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) invited Namrood to worship one Allah, and Namrood had him thrown into a fire, which Allah made cool.
Hazrat Musa (AS) was sent to Pharaoh (Firaun).
What is the antonym of accept?
To accept means to receive or agree to something, and its opposite is to reject or refuse.
Decline and refuse are also antonyms of accept.
Which prophet (AS) was sent to Pharaoh (Firaun)?
Allah sent Hazrat Musa (AS), together with his brother Hazrat Harun (AS), to invite Pharaoh to the truth and to free Bani Israel.
Hazrat Musa (AS) is called Kaleem-ullah (one who spoke to Allah).
Adnan is 12 years old and his sister is 2 times his age. What will be the age of the sister after 8 years?
The sister's age now is 2 x 12 = 24 years. After 8 years she will be 24 + 8 = 32 years.
Age problems are solved by first finding present ages and then adding the years that pass.
FSB is the intelligence agency of which country?
The FSB (Federal Security Service) is the main security and counter-intelligence agency of the Russian Federation. It replaced the Soviet-era KGB's domestic functions.
The foreign intelligence agency of Russia is the SVR.
MI5 is the security agency of which country?
MI5, the Security Service, is the domestic counter-intelligence and security agency of the United Kingdom.
MI6 (the Secret Intelligence Service) handles British foreign intelligence.
MOIS is the intelligence agency of which country?
MOIS is the Ministry of Intelligence of the Islamic Republic of Iran, also known as VAJA.
Pakistan's main intelligence agency is the Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI).
Faiq and Ahmad were born in 1970 and 1977 respectively. What are their ages in 1999?
Age equals the given year minus the birth year.
Which is the main fighter aircraft of the Pakistan Air Force developed jointly with China?
The JF-17 Thunder is a lightweight multirole fighter built jointly by Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Kamra and China's Chengdu Aircraft Corporation.
Pakistan also operates the F-16 and the Chinese J-10C.
Which is the national airline of Russia?
Aeroflot is the flag carrier and largest airline of Russia, based in Moscow.
Lufthansa is from Germany and Emirates from the UAE.
Who is the current Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) as of October 2026?
Barrister Syed Iftikhar Ali Gilani of PML-N was elected the 17th Prime Minister of AJK on 28 August 2026 after the July-August 2026 elections.
Faisal Mumtaz Rathore was the previous prime minister before the 2026 elections.
Who was the President of Azad Jammu and Kashmir before Dr Najeeb Naqi?
Sultan Mehmood Chaudhry was President of AJK from 2021 until his death on 31 January 2026. Acting presidents served until Dr Najeeb Naqi took oath in September 2026.
Chaudhry Latif Akbar acted as president for part of that interim period.
Who was the first President of Azad Jammu and Kashmir?
Sardar Muhammad Ibrahim Khan became the first President of Azad Kashmir in October 1947 after the Poonch uprising.
He served four non-consecutive terms and is called Ghazi-e-Millat.
Akbar is older than Zarnab, and Ali is older than Akbar. Who is the youngest?
Ali is older than Akbar, and Akbar is older than Zarnab, so the order from oldest is Ali, Akbar, Zarnab. Zarnab is the youngest.
Ranking questions are solved by placing the names in a single line from oldest to youngest.
Akram is 3 times as old as Zahra, whose age is 4 years. What will be Akram's age after 22 years?
Akram's age now is 3 x 4 = 12 years. After 22 years he will be 12 + 22 = 34 years.
Always find the present age first, then add the number of years.
The expression 3y - 2x + 3 is an algebraic what?
It has variables, constants and operations but no equals sign, so it is an algebraic expression, not an equation.
This expression has three terms: 3y, -2x and 3.
Muhammad Ali Sadpara was a famous Pakistani high-altitude mountaineer from Skardu who climbed eight-thousanders such as Nanga Parbat in winter.
He went missing on K2 in February 2021 during a winter attempt.
In the sentence 'Aliya is going to school', what part of speech is the word Aliya?
Aliya is the name of a person, so it is a proper noun.
A pronoun such as she would replace the name Aliya in the sentence.
Who was the first Pakistani woman cricketer to take 100 ODI wickets?
Sana Mir became the first Pakistani woman to take 100 ODI wickets in February 2017 against Bangladesh in the World Cup Qualifier.
She finished her ODI career with about 150 ODI wickets, the most by a Pakistani woman, and was inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame.
Khalil-ullah is the title of which prophet?
Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) is called Khalil-ullah, meaning friend of Allah.
Hazrat Musa (AS) is Kaleem-ullah and Hazrat Isa (AS) is Ruh-ullah.
On what date was Allama Muhammad Iqbal born?
Allama Iqbal was born in Sialkot on 9 November 1877.
He died in Lahore on 21 April 1938.
Which letter comes next after O in the English alphabet?
The alphabet runs ... M, N, O, P, Q, so P comes right after O.
What is the position of the letter O in the English alphabet?
Counting A=1 to O gives A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, so O is the 15th letter.
The 26 letters have 5 vowels: A, E, I, O, U.
In which country does the world's largest volunteer ambulance service operate?
The Edhi Foundation of Pakistan runs the largest volunteer ambulance network in the world, recognised by Guinness World Records.
The Edhi Foundation was founded by Abdul Sattar Edhi, known as the Angel of Mercy.
Boxer Amir Khan, a former world champion, belongs to which country?
Amir Khan was born in Bolton, England, and represented Great Britain; he is of Pakistani descent.
He won an Olympic silver medal in 2004 at Athens.
Which word is the antonym of anarchy?
Anarchy means a state of disorder and absence of government, so its opposite is order.
Chaos, disorder and lawlessness are synonyms of anarchy.
How many interior angles does a square have?
A square is a quadrilateral with four corners, so it has four angles, each of 90 degrees.
The four angles of a square add up to 360 degrees.
Which is the largest animal in the world?
The blue whale grows up to about 30 metres in length and weighs up to nearly 200 tonnes, bigger than any other animal.
The African elephant is the largest living land animal.
In which year did Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah announce his 14 Points?
Jinnah presented his 14 Points in March 1929 in Delhi as a reply to the Nehru Report.
The 14 Points set out the minimum constitutional demands of the Muslims of India.
On which date was the plan for the partition and independence of India announced?
Lord Mountbatten announced the Partition Plan, known as the 3 June Plan, on 3 June 1947.
The Indian Independence Act was passed by the British Parliament on 18 July 1947.
What is the solution of the equation 3x - 7 = -x + 9?
Move x terms to the left: 3x + x = 9 + 7, so 4x = 16 and x = 4.
Check: 3(4) - 7 = 5 and -4 + 9 = 5, so both sides are equal.
What is the antonym of perfect?
Perfect means without any fault, so the opposite is faulty or imperfect.
Flawless, ideal and exact are synonyms of perfect.
What is the antonym of abuse?
Abuse means to treat badly or insult, so its opposite is to respect or treat well.
Mistreat, insult and harm are close in meaning to abuse.
What is the antonym of arbitrary?
Arbitrary means based on random choice rather than reason, so its opposite is reasoned.
Random and whimsical are synonyms of arbitrary.
What is the antonym of blunt?
Blunt means not sharp or having no fine edge, so the opposite is sharp.
Blunt can also mean frank and outspoken in speech.
What is the antonym of callousness?
Callousness is cruel lack of feeling for others, and its opposite is compassion.
Callous is an adjective and comes from the Latin word for hard skin.
What is the antonym of elated?
Elated means very happy and proud, and its opposite is depressed or downcast.
Joyful, excited and cheerful are close in meaning to elated.
What is the antonym of error?
An error is a mistake, so the opposite is accuracy or correctness.
Mistake, fault and blunder are synonyms of error.
What is the antonym of evident?
Evident means clearly seen or understood, so its opposite is obscure or unclear.
Obvious, clear and plain are synonyms of evident.
What is the antonym of frugal?
Frugal means careful in spending money, and its opposite is extravagant or wasteful.
Thrifty, careful and economical are synonyms of frugal.
What is the antonym of imminent?
Imminent means about to happen soon, so its opposite is remote or distant.
Do not confuse imminent with eminent, which means famous.
What is the antonym of liberal?
Liberal means open to new ideas and tolerant of others, so its opposite is conservative or narrow-minded.
Liberal can also mean generous in giving.
What is the antonym of magnanimous?
Magnanimous means generous and forgiving, especially toward a rival, so its opposite is petty or mean-spirited.
Selfish is also given as an opposite in some word lists.
What is the antonym of wail?
To wail is to cry loudly in grief, so the opposite is to rejoice.
Cry, lament and weep are close in meaning to wail.
Masjid Aqsa stands in the old city of Jerusalem in Palestine.
It was the first qibla of the Muslims and is the third holiest mosque in Islam.
Saudi riyal is the currency of which country?
The riyal is the official currency of Saudi Arabia, issued by the Saudi Central Bank.
Qatar and Oman also use a currency called riyal, but the Saudi riyal belongs to Saudi Arabia.
The Rann of Kutch is a marshy region lying between Sindh (Pakistan) and which Indian state?
The Rann of Kutch is a large salt marsh between the Sindh province of Pakistan and the Indian state of Gujarat.
A 1965 border dispute over the Rann was settled by an international tribunal in 1968.
If 6 is the arithmetic mean between 4 and B, what is the value of B?
Mean = (4 + B) / 2 = 6, so 4 + B = 12 and B = 8.
The arithmetic mean of two numbers lies exactly midway between them.
What is the arithmetic mean of 18 and 36?
The arithmetic mean is the sum of the values divided by their number.
What is the arithmetic mean of (y + 3) and (y - 2)?
Check with y = 1: the numbers are 4 and -1, whose mean is 1.5, which equals 1 + 0.5.
What is the walking seven times between the hills of Safa and Marwa during Hajj called?
Sa'i is the ritual walk between Safa and Marwa, commemorating Hazrat Hajra's search for water for Ismail (AS).
The Zamzam well appeared near the Kaaba after this search.
In the word MANAGEMENT, arranged alphabetically, which letter is second last?
Alphabetical order is A A E E G M M N N T. The last letter is T and the second last is N.
MANAGEMENT has 10 letters, with A, E, M and N each appearing twice.
If the letters of the word MANAGEMENT are arranged alphabetically, which letter is third last?
Alphabetical order is A A E E G M M N N T. From the end: T, N, N, so the third last is N.
The letters N appear twice, in the 8th and 9th places.
Boxing is called the noble art of what?
Boxing has long been called the noble art of self-defence.
Modern boxing rules are based on the Marquess of Queensberry rules of 1867.
In which year was Benazir Bhutto assassinated?
Benazir Bhutto was assassinated on 27 December 2007 in Rawalpindi after an election rally.
She was the first woman Prime Minister of a Muslim country.
Who promulgates ordinances in Pakistan when the National Assembly is not in session?
Under Article 89 of the Constitution, the President may promulgate an ordinance when Parliament is not in session.
An ordinance must be laid before Parliament and lapses after 120 days unless extended or approved.
What is the currency of Australia?
Australia used the Australian pound until decimal currency was introduced in 1966.
Who is the Prime Minister of Australia (as of 2026)?
Anthony Albanese of the Labor Party has been Prime Minister since May 2022.
His predecessor Scott Morrison served from 2018 to 2022.
Who is the author of the book India of My Dreams?
India of My Dreams is a collection of the writings of Mahatma Gandhi on his vision for India, compiled by R. K. Prabhu.
Gandhi's autobiography is titled The Story of My Experiments with Truth.
Who is the author of the book In the Line of Fire?
In the Line of Fire (2006) is the memoir of General Pervez Musharraf.
It was published when Musharraf was President of Pakistan.
Who is the author of the book Mein Kampf?
Mein Kampf (My Struggle) was written by Adolf Hitler, partly while he was in prison in 1924.
It was published in two volumes in 1925 and 1926.
What is the meaning of the word autonomy?
Autonomy means the right or ability of a person, group or region to govern itself and make its own decisions.
An autonomous region is one that has its own local government within a larger country.
A boy has an average of 50 marks in 5 tests. How many marks must he score in the 6th test to raise his average to 70?
Total of 5 tests = 50 x 5 = 250. Total needed for 6 tests = 70 x 6 = 420, so the next score is 420 - 250 = 170.
Average = sum of all values divided by the number of values.
At what age did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) pass away?
The Holy Prophet (PBUH) passed away in 11 AH (632 AD) at the age of 63 years.
He passed away on 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal in Madina.
The line x = 5 is parallel to which axis?
It is parallel to no axis
All points on x = 5 have the same x value, so it is a vertical line parallel to the y-axis.
The equation x = 0 is the y-axis itself.
The line y = 6 is parallel to which axis?
All points on y = 6 have the same y value, so it is a horizontal line parallel to the x-axis, crossing the y-axis at (0, 6).
The equation y = 0 is the x-axis itself.
Which constitution of Pakistan was introduced by Ayub Khan?
Field Marshal Ayub Khan introduced the presidential constitution of 1962.
The 1962 constitution was abrogated in 1969 when Yahya Khan imposed martial law.
What is the name of the autobiography of Field Marshal Ayub Khan?
Ayub Khan wrote Friends Not Masters, published in 1967.
In the Line of Fire is the autobiography of Pervez Musharraf.
Who is Azazeel, according to Islamic tradition?
Azazeel is the name by which Iblis (Shaitan) was known before he refused to prostrate to Hazrat Adam (AS).
Iblis was a jinn who lived among the angels.
Rehman Baba was a famous poet of which language?
Rehman Baba (17th century) is a celebrated Sufi poet of the Pashto language.
A boy walks 10 miles north, turns back and walks 10 miles, then turns right and again turns right. Which direction is he facing now?
After turning back he walks south and faces south. Turning right from south he faces west, and turning right again he faces north.
A right turn is a 90 degree clockwise turn.
In which city of Pakistan is Liaquat Bagh located?
Liaquat Bagh is a park in Rawalpindi where Liaquat Ali Khan was assassinated in 1951.
It is also known for the 2007 assassination of Benazir Bhutto nearby.
On which date did the Jallianwala Bagh massacre take place?
British troops under General Dyer fired on a crowd in Amritsar on 13 April 1919, the Baisakhi day.
The massacre led to a wave of anti-British feeling in India.
Who is the Prime Minister of Bangladesh (as of 2026)?
Tarique Rahman of the BNP became Prime Minister on 17 February 2026 after the general election.
Before him Muhammad Yunus led the interim government after Sheikh Hasina left in 2024.
In which year was the World Bank established?
The World Bank was set up at the Bretton Woods Conference in 1944 and began operations in 1946.
Its headquarters is in Washington, D.C.

Banu Quraiza were a Jewish tribe living near Madinah. They broke their agreement with the Muslims during the Battle of the Trench (Khandaq).
After the Trench, the Muslims besieged their fortress and the matter was settled by the judgement of Hazrat Saad bin Muadh (RA).
What do the names of Surah Al-Fatiha and Surah Al-Baqarah mean in English?
Al-Fatiha means The Opening and Al-Baqarah means The Cow.
Al-Baqarah is the longest surah of the Quran, and Al-Fatiha is its first.
Where is the Sukkur Barrage located?
Sukkur Barrage is built on the River Indus at Sukkur in the province of Sindh.
It was completed in 1932 and feeds seven major canals.
What is the area of a triangle with base 3 cm and height 6 cm?
Area = half x base x height = 0.5 x 3 x 6 = 9 square cm.
Candidates often forget the half and give 18, which is the area of the rectangle.
What is the area of a triangle with base 6 cm and height 24 cm?
Area = half x base x height = 0.5 x 6 x 24 = 72 square cm.
The area of a triangle is always half of the rectangle with the same base and height.
What is the height of a triangle whose base is 6 cm and area is 24 square cm?
Area = half x base x height, so 24 = 0.5 x 6 x h = 3h. Therefore h = 8 cm.
Height = 2 x area divided by base.
Which one is different: Baseball, Table tennis, Hockey, Football?
Baseball, table tennis and hockey are played with a bat, paddle or stick, while football needs no such equipment in hand.
Football is played with a round ball kicked by the feet.
Is the 1973 Constitution of Pakistan based on a parliamentary or a presidential system?
The 1973 Constitution set up a parliamentary form of government with the Prime Minister as chief executive and the President as head of state.
The 1962 Constitution, by contrast, was presidential.
On which basis was Pakistan created, according to the resolution passed in 1940?
The Lahore Resolution of 23 March 1940, based on the Two-Nation Theory, demanded separate Muslim states and led to Pakistan.

Who is known as Afzalul Bashar Ba'd al-Anbiya (best of mankind after the prophets)?
Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) is called Afzalul Bashar Ba'd al-Anbiya, the best of mankind after the prophets.
He was the first Caliph of Islam and the closest companion of the Prophet (PBUH).
Which international organization mediated the Indus Waters (Basin) Treaty of 1960?
The World Bank brokered the negotiations that led to the Indus Waters Treaty signed in Karachi in 1960.
India and Pakistan agreed on a division of the six rivers of the Indus system.
Ali is 4 years old and his sister is twice his age. When Ali becomes 8 years old, how old will his sister be?
Sister is 2 x 4 = 8 years now. Ali needs 4 more years to be 8, so sister will be 8 + 4 = 12.
The age difference between two people never changes.
Sarmad is 5 years old and his sister is two times his age. How old will his sister be when Sarmad is 11?
Sister is 2 x 5 = 10 now. Sarmad needs 6 more years to reach 11, so the sister will be 10 + 6 = 16.
Both ages grow by the same number of years.
Change into active voice: The rooms are being decorated by the students.
The students were decorating the rooms.
The students are decorating the rooms.
The students have decorated the rooms.
The passive present continuous (are being decorated) becomes the active present continuous (are decorating).
In active voice the doer becomes the subject.
Fill in the blank: Did the students ----- a lot of work in class?
After the auxiliary did the verb takes its base form, so have is correct.
In questions with did, the main verb never takes the past form.
To what name was Islamabad's Kashmir Highway changed in August 2020?
In August 2020 the government renamed Kashmir Highway in Islamabad as Srinagar Highway to show solidarity with Kashmiris.
